title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 3
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 3: supply and support taken from Jerusalem, oppressive leaders, and the finery of the daughters of Zion removed.

questions.text: What whole supply does the Lord take away from Jerusalem and from Judah?
questions.explanation: The Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away supply and support, the whole supply of bread and the whole supply of water.

questions.text: Who does Yahweh say He will give to be their princes?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says, "I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them."

questions.text: Why does a man ask his brother to be their ruler?
questions.explanation: A man takes hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, "You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand."

answers.text: Because he is a man of war

questions.text: What does the man cry out when asked to rule?
questions.explanation: He cries out, "I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people."

questions.text: Like which city do the people parade their sin without hiding it?
questions.explanation: The text says, "They parade their sin like Sodom. They don't hide it."

questions.text: Who are the oppressors of God's people, and who rules over them?
questions.explanation: The text says, "As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them."

answers.text: Strangers oppress them and kings rule over them
Princes oppress them and judges rule over them
Children are their oppressors and women rule over them
Soldiers oppress them and priests rule over them

questions.text: What does Yahweh accuse the elders and leaders of having eaten up?
questions.explanation: Yahweh enters into judgment with the elders and leaders: "It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The plunder of the poor is in your houses."

questions.text: What will Yahweh do to the daughters of Zion because they are arrogant?
questions.explanation: Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant, the Lord brings sores on the crown of their heads, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.

answers.text: Shut them out of the city

questions.text: What will there be instead of a belt?
questions.explanation: The text says that instead of a belt there shall be a rope, and instead of well set hair, baldness.

questions.text: How will the men of Zion fall?
questions.explanation: The text says, "Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war."
